what_lands.qwk: quadraticWeightedKappa (teachermarking/index.ts, the cohenKappa sibling — pure, total): QWK over paired ordinal level placements [smart, human]; categories 1..K with K = the largest level observed across BOTH raters; weights w_ij = (i-j)²/(K-1)²; QWK drops into the existing kappa column per ADR-040 §2.3. observedAgreement carries the UNWEIGHTED exact-placement agreement (the ADR's disclosure law for that column). Degenerate conventions documented (K=1 → 1; zero weighted-chance denominator → 1 iff observed perfect) — the D5-β level-span floor refuses the unanimity packet upstream, so the conventions make the pure function total, never a pass path. Verified against hand-computed vectors: perfect → 1; balanced 2×2 → 0; near-miss ordinal case → 0.5; a designed 30-pair disagreeing packet → −0.2857…; same-marginals distance test (step-1 vs step-2 misses → 0 vs −1).
what_lands.d5_beta_floors: pre-registered in CODE (BAND_FLOOR_* constants, assertBandFloors): n_pairs ≥ 25 scored; scored ≥ 50% of the packet; capture ≥ 80%; packet level-span ≥ 2 distinct teacher placements; ≥ 10 boundary-straddling pairs (teacher mark within ONE mark of the placed band's edge — the smart run's mark_scheme_id anchors the ranges via ONE batched `= any(${ids}::uuid[])` mark_bands read, no N+1). UNMET floors → ONE ConflictError naming every shortfall with its real numbers, NO evaluation row: absence of an evaluation stays gated (fail-closed) and a degenerate packet can never mint a passing κ row. Override + teacher-authorship + disclosure clauses unchanged (the point D5 law).
what_lands.packet_definition: the band packet = human marks in scope CARRYING a band_placement (the teacher's explicit capture — zero inference from scheme shapes); scored = those that paired against a VALIDATED band-shaped smart run with non-null placements both sides; captured = packet answers with a smart run (any). Skips documented, never errors (mirrors collectPairs' posture).
